meta.theme_name_note: Renamed by the user directly in style.css on 2026-08-27 (was 'Hex'). Admin UI reads the name live via wp_get_theme() rather than hardcoding it, so further renames need no code change.
meta.type: WordPress theme (classic PHP templates, not a block/FSE theme)
meta.purpose: Standalone custom WordPress theme with exactly three selectable page templates (Default, Full Width, Canvas), a GitHub-based self-updater, a child-theme installer (fetches + validates + installs from GitHub, does not auto-generate) with its own fully independent GitHub self-updater, a YOOtheme-Pro-scale admin-configurable design-token system (Theme Options: ~146 fields / 12 groups — typography incl. line-height/letter-spacing/weight/margin, spacing, a 15-color palette, buttons with variants, forms, cards, sections, global radius, tables, alerts, badges, icons — applied via runtime CSS custom properties, no rebuild needed, gated on an active child theme, tabbed admin UI), and a Tailwind-CSS-styled theme management admin dashboard carrying the Hexnity brand (logo + color palette). Front end uses Tailwind CSS + Animate.css but a neutral palette — no brand color/logo there, by explicit user instruction.
meta.boundary: All work is strictly confined to this theme directory. See claude.md.

docs.claude.md: Base file. Boundaries, rules, and read-order instructions. Always read first.
docs.action-map.json: Chronological log of every action taken against a user requirement.
docs.project.json: This file. Structure/files/functions index — read here before opening real files.
docs.features/: One md file per complete feature, updated whenever that feature changes.
docs.knoladge/: Implementation notes, decisions, and documented failures/errors, kept for reuse.
docs.github.md: Reference doc (from a prior/related project) describing a GitHub-based self-updater mechanism. This theme's own updater (inc/updater.php) follows its architecture but is admin-configured rather than hardcoded — see features/github-updater.md.
docs.README.md: Public-facing project readme: features, requirements, dev setup, testing/linting/build commands, license.
docs.LICENSE: Full GPLv2 (or later) license text, matching style.css's License field.

lib/plugin-update-checker/ (vendored third-party library, runtime-loaded, see features/github-updater.md)
assets: css/src/site-theme.css (~146 design-token @theme entries + base h1-h6/body/link rules + .btn/.card/.form-control/.alert/.badge/.table-styled/.icon components + .prose heading overrides — front-end only, see features/design-system.md)
css/src/front.css (front-end Tailwind entry: Preflight + typography plugin + site-theme.css; no theme.css import)
css/src/admin.css (admin Tailwind entry: theme+utilities, no Preflight, + theme.css)
images/hexnity-dark.png (full logo, admin-only usage — dashboard sidebar, h-11)

style.css.purpose: Theme header (metadata) only — WordPress requires this file to exist/identify the theme. No hand-written CSS body anymore.
style.css.notes: Version: header (currently 1.5.0) must always match functions.php's HEX_VERSION constant AND tests/bootstrap.php's HEX_VERSION define (3 copies total — bump all 3 on every theme change, see claude.md). Enforced by tests/ThemeFilesTest.php::test_style_css_version_matches_hex_version_constant. Real styling is assets/css/tailwind.css.

functions.php.purpose: Theme bootstrap. Defines HEX_VERSION, HEX_THEME_DIR, HEX_THEME_URI; requires every inc/ file; requires inc/admin/* only when is_admin().

inc/setup.php.purpose: Theme supports, nav menu registration, content width, and the page-templates data map.
functions: hex_setup() — hooked to after_setup_theme; registers theme supports + nav menus.
hex_content_width() — hooked to after_setup_theme (priority 0); sets $GLOBALS['content_width'], filterable via 'hex_content_width'.
hex_get_page_templates() — returns the file => label map for the 3 page templates; single source of truth, also used by tests.

inc/enqueue.php.purpose: Registers/enqueues compiled Tailwind CSS, vendored Animate.css, and navigation.js on the front end.
functions: hex_enqueue_assets() — hooked to wp_enqueue_scripts. Enqueues hex-style (style.css header), hex-animate (animate.min.css), hex-tailwind (tailwind.css), hex-navigation (navigation.js).

inc/template-tags.php.purpose: Template helper functions shared across template files, incl. the per-template title/chrome visibility logic.
functions: hex_posted_on() — echoes published/updated <time> markup.
hex_posted_by() — echoes linked author byline.
hex_entry_footer() — echoes categories/tags/edit link for posts.
hex_should_show_title() — false only for template-full-width.php and template-canvas.php.
hex_should_show_chrome() — false only for template-canvas.php.
hex_register_widget_areas() — hooked to widgets_init.

inc/customizer.php.purpose: Registers the Customizer 'Layout Options' section and the footer-text setting.
functions: hex_customize_register( $wp_customize ) — hooked to customize_register.
hex_sanitize_footer_text( $input ) — strips all HTML, then sanitize_text_field().

inc/security.php.purpose: Baseline hardening: removes the WP version generator tag and the X-Pingback header.
functions: hex_remove_version_generator() — filters 'the_generator' to ''.
hex_remove_pingback_header( $headers ) — filters 'wp_headers' to unset X-Pingback.

inc/updater.php.purpose: GitHub-based self-updater. See features/github-updater.md for full detail.
functions: hex_get_github_repo() / hex_get_github_branch() / hex_get_activation_key() — thin get_option() wrappers.
hex_get_update_checker( $repo_override = null ) — builds/caches the PucFactory checker; null when no repo configured.
hex_check_for_theme_update() — one-line human-readable manual check result.
hex_perform_theme_update() — checks and installs via Theme_Upgrader if an update exists.

inc/admin/settings.php.purpose: Settings API registration for the Updates page (main repo/branch/token), the Child Theme page (separate child repo/branch/token), and the Theme Options page (full design-token schema, generic field renderer) + sanitize callbacks.
functions: hex_register_update_settings() — hooked to admin_init.
hex_sanitize_github_repo( $value ) — validates owner/repo format, records a settings error and returns '' if invalid.
hex_sanitize_github_branch( $value ) — trim + sanitize_text_field().
hex_render_github_repo_field() / hex_render_github_branch_field() / hex_render_activation_key_field().
hex_register_child_theme_settings() — hooked to admin_init. Separate settings group 'hex_child_updates'.
hex_sanitize_child_github_repo( $value ) — same validation as hex_sanitize_github_repo(), distinct settings-error identifier.
hex_render_child_github_repo_field() / hex_render_child_github_branch_field() / hex_render_child_activation_key_field().

hex_register_style_settings() — hooked to admin_init. Loops hex_get_style_schema() to register_setting() every hex_style_* option (no add_settings_section/field — fields are rendered directly by page-theme-options.php's tabbed layout, not the default form-table).

hex_render_style_field( $args ) — generic field renderer for all 6 field types (color-swatch+text / weight select / shadow-preset select / font text with list="hex-google-fonts-list" / length+number text).
hex_render_style_group_fields( $group ) — renders every field belonging to one schema group as label+input pairs, used inside each tab panel.
hex_render_google_fonts_field() — the 'Google Fonts' textarea + resolved-family chip list, rendered once at the top of the Typography panel only.

inc/admin/menu.php.purpose: Registers the top-level admin menu (fixed label 'Hexnity WP' — deliberately NOT wp_get_theme()->get('Name') per user request, icon = plain 'dashicons-art') + Dashboard/Updates/About/Child Theme/Theme Options submenus; scopes tailwind-admin.css/admin.js to just these screens.
functions: hex_register_admin_menu() — hooked to admin_menu.
hex_admin_screen_hooks( $hooks = null ) — static-backed store/read of this menu's hook suffixes.
hex_enqueue_admin_assets( $hook ) — hooked to admin_enqueue_scripts.

inc/admin/partials.php.purpose: Shared app-shell dashboard chrome for all five admin pages: hex_render_admin_shell_start( $active, $title, $description )/hex_render_admin_shell_end() render a persistent dark hexnity-branded sidebar (logo, 5-item icon nav, version footer) plus an equally dark content pane (bg-gray-950/900) with its own header bar. hex_render_admin_icon() prints one of a fixed set of inline SVGs built from plain shapes (rect/circle/line, not copied path data). hex_render_admin_stat_tile() is the icon+value+label tile used in the Dashboard's stat row (indigo icon chip). hex_render_admin_submit_button() renders a .hex-btn.hex-btn-primary submit button in place of WP core's submit_button(), which is styled for a light theme. General interactive accent is Tailwind's indigo scale, not hexnity-* (user: 'u dont need to strict with logo colors' — see knoladge/admin-dark-theme-components.md). Nav active/inactive text colors use Tailwind's ! important-modifier since WP core's unlayered admin CSS otherwise beats layered Tailwind utilities — see knoladge/tailwind-cascade-layers-vs-wp-admin.md.
functions: hex_admin_nav_items()
hex_render_admin_icon( $name, $classes )
hex_render_admin_shell_start( $active, $title, $description )
hex_render_admin_shell_end()
hex_render_admin_stat_tile( $icon, $value, $label )
hex_render_admin_submit_button( $label, $disabled )

inc/admin/handlers.php.purpose: admin-post.php handlers for the Updates and Child Theme pages' action buttons. (Theme Options has no admin-post handler — it saves via the plain Settings API / options.php, like the other settings forms already do for Save Changes.)
functions: hex_handle_check_updates() — admin_post_hex_check_updates.
hex_handle_perform_update() — admin_post_hex_perform_update.
hex_handle_install_child_theme() — admin_post_hex_install_child_theme.
hex_handle_check_child_updates() — admin_post_hex_check_child_updates.
hex_handle_perform_child_update() — admin_post_hex_perform_child_update.

inc/admin/page-dashboard.php.purpose: Dashboard page render: a 4-tile stat row (theme version, page template count, style-settings count, child-theme active state) via hex_render_admin_stat_tile(), then the existing Tailwind card grid (updates status, page templates, nav menus, quick links).

inc/admin/page-updates.php.purpose: Updates page render (Tailwind cards): settings form + Check Now / Check & Update Now buttons + last-run log.

inc/admin/page-about.php.purpose: About page render (Tailwind definition list): theme metadata straight from wp_get_theme().

inc/admin/page-child-theme.php.purpose: Child Theme page render: repo/branch/token settings form, status card (Activated / Installed-not-active / none, per hex_is_child_theme_active()), 'Fetch & Install Child Theme' button (hidden while active), Check/Update buttons.

inc/admin/page-theme-options.php.purpose: Theme Options page render, inside the shared shell: left-category tab nav (12 groups) + right detail panel with card-style panel headers (JS-driven, assets/js/admin.js), all fields wrapped in a <fieldset disabled> unless hex_is_child_theme_active(), an amber notice + link to Child Theme when disabled, and a sticky bottom save bar.

inc/child-theme.php.purpose: Fetches, validates (Template: header must match this theme), and installs a child theme from GitHub — not auto-generated — plus its own independent GitHub self-updater. See features/child-theme.md for full detail.
functions: hex_fetch_remote_child_style_css( $repo, $branch ) — wp_remote_get()s raw.githubusercontent.com/{repo}/{branch}/style.css, parses Theme Name:/Template: headers.
hex_validate_child_theme_repo( $repo, $branch ) — rejects unless the fetched Template: matches get_template().

hex_install_child_theme_from_repo( $repo, $branch ) — validates, then installs the branch zip via Theme_Upgrader->install(), renaming the extracted {repo}-{branch}/ folder via an upgrader_source_selection filter.

hex_get_child_theme_slug() — prefers the LIVE active child (is_child_theme() ? get_stylesheet() : ...) over the tracked hex_child_theme_slug option, so any child of this theme is detected regardless of how it was installed (fixed a real bug where a manually-activated child theme wasn't recognized).
hex_get_child_github_repo() / hex_get_child_github_branch() / hex_get_child_activation_key() — thin get_option() wrappers, separate option names from the parent's.
hex_is_child_theme_active() — is_child_theme() directly; drives the admin page's Install-vs-Activated UI states.
hex_get_child_update_checker() — separate PucFactory instance pointed at the child's own style.css (via wp_get_theme($slug), works whether or not the child is active).
hex_check_for_child_theme_update() / hex_perform_child_theme_update() — mirror the parent's equivalents, operating on the child.

inc/style-settings.php.purpose: The admin-configurable design-token schema — ~146 fields across 12 groups (typography/spacing/colors/buttons/forms/cards/sections/global/tables/alerts/badges/icons) — + runtime CSS custom property output. See features/design-system.md for full detail. Loaded unconditionally — the front end needs it on every request.
functions: hex_get_style_schema() — the single source of truth, built with loops for repetitive families (heading levels, button/alert/badge variants) rather than ~146 hand-written literals.
hex_get_style_groups() — the 12 group labels in display order.
hex_style_humanize_key( $key ) — snake_case -> Title Case, used to auto-label loop-built fields.
hex_get_shadow_presets() — fixed keyword -> real box-shadow CSS map (none/sm/md/lg/xl); the CSS itself is NOT admin-editable, only which preset applies.
hex_style_option_name( $key ) / hex_style_css_var_name( $key ) — naming transforms (hex_style_{key} option, --hex-{key with hyphens} CSS var).
hex_get_style_value( $key ) / hex_get_all_style_values() — saved option or schema default (shadow fields return the raw keyword, not the resolved CSS).

hex_is_safe_style_value( $value ) / hex_is_safe_font_value( $value ) — output-time injection defenses (independent of the sanitize callbacks) for the two value shapes that can't share one charset check.

hex_render_style_css_vars() — hooked to wp_head; prints <style id="hex-style-vars">:root{...}</style> from current values (resolving shadow keywords to real CSS first) on every front-end request regardless of child-theme-active state.
hex_style_key_from_option_name( $option_name ) / hex_style_revert_from_filter() — used by every sanitize callback to recover the previous/default value to revert to on invalid input.

hex_sanitize_style_length() / hex_sanitize_style_number() / hex_sanitize_style_color() / hex_sanitize_style_weight() / hex_sanitize_style_shadow() / hex_sanitize_style_font() — one per field type; all reject-and-revert (never store empty/invalid).
hex_style_sanitize_callback_for_type( $type ) — maps a schema field type to its sanitize callback function name.

header.php.purpose: Opens <html>/<body>, skip link, site branding (text-large fallback title), primary nav. Neutral Tailwind styling (gray scale, no logo/brand color — see features/brand-styling.md). Used by every template except template-canvas.php.

footer.php.purpose: Footer widgets, footer nav, site-info/copyright (text-small), closes <body>/<html>. Neutral Tailwind styling. Used by every template except template-canvas.php.

index.php.purpose: Fallback loop template for any query without a more specific template.

page.php.purpose: Implicit default page template (no explicit template selected). Renders template-parts/content-page.php.

single.php.purpose: Single post template: content, comments, post navigation.

archive.php.purpose: Category/tag/date/author archive listing. Title uses text-h1 (design-token, see features/design-system.md).

search.php.purpose: Search results listing. Title uses text-h1.

404.php.purpose: Not Found page with a search form. Title uses text-h1 (weight/letter-spacing now via base h1{} rule); card uses .card component.

comments.php.purpose: Comment list + comment form, included via comments_template(). Comments title uses text-h3; 'closed' notice uses text-small.

template-default.php.purpose: Template Name: Default. Explicitly selectable equivalent of page.php — header, title, content, footer.

template-full-width.php.purpose: Template Name: Full Width. Header/footer shown, title and max-width constraint suppressed.

template-canvas.php.purpose: Template Name: Canvas. No header, no footer, no title — content only, own minimal <html> shell.

template-parts/content.php.purpose: Post entry rendering for loop contexts (index/archive/search). Uses .card component; title text-h1 (singular)/text-h2 (list item, hover:text-site-primary), meta/footer text-small, animate__fadeIn.

template-parts/content-none.php.purpose: Empty-result state, incl. search form when the query was a search. Title text-h2; card uses .card component.

template-parts/content-page.php.purpose: Page title (text-h1, conditional on hex_should_show_title()) + content ('prose' typography — headings inside also respond to Theme Options via site-theme.css's .prose overrides). Shared by page.php and template-default.php.

assets/js/navigation.js.purpose: Accessible mobile menu toggle: toggles Tailwind hidden/flex classes on #site-navigation ul.

assets/js/admin.js.purpose: Confirm-dialog guard on the 'Check & Update Now' form.

assets/css/src/theme.css.purpose: hexnity-{50..900} Tailwind v4 @theme color tokens, extracted from the real logo pixel color #009688 (Material Teal 500). Imported only by admin.css.

assets/css/src/front.css.purpose: Front-end Tailwind entry: full Tailwind incl. Preflight + @tailwindcss/typography. Does NOT import theme.css — front end has no brand color.

assets/css/src/admin.css.purpose: Admin Tailwind entry: tailwindcss/theme + tailwindcss/utilities only (no Preflight, so it doesn't reset the rest of wp-admin's chrome) + theme.css, plus a @layer components block of admin-only UI components (.hex-btn/-primary/-secondary/-danger, .hex-field, .hex-color-swatch, .hex-label) and dark-theme restyles for WP-core-rendered markup we don't control classes on (.form-table, .notice, .description). Several rules use Tailwind's ! important-modifier since WP core's own admin CSS is unlayered — see knoladge/admin-dark-theme-components.md.

assets/css/tailwind.css.purpose: Compiled front-end CSS (npm run build:css:front). Shipped/committed like inc/lib — WordPress can't run the npm build in production.

assets/css/tailwind-admin.css.purpose: Compiled admin CSS (npm run build:css:admin). Shipped/committed.

assets/vendor/animate.min.css.purpose: Vendored Animate.css (from npm package, copied — same pattern as inc/lib/plugin-update-checker/). Front-end only.

assets/images/hexnity-dark.png.purpose: The user's actual logo (downloaded from https://hexnity.com/images/hexnity-dark.png). White wordmark — needs a dark background. Admin-only usage: the dashboard sidebar (h-11, bumped from h-7 per user request 'make the logo little bigger'). The wp-admin sidebar menu icon uses a plain dashicon instead, not this image (a cropped-mark version was tried and removed per user request).

inc/google-fonts.php.purpose: Admin-configurable, API-free Google Fonts picker: the admin pastes a Google Fonts embed link (or the whole 3-line snippet); family names are parsed straight out of the stylesheet URL's own query string and fed into a shared <datalist> that every 'font'-type Theme Options field points to. See knoladge/google-fonts-picker.md and features/design-system.md.
functions: hex_sanitize_google_fonts_urls( $value ) — regexes out only genuine https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?... substrings (so pasting the whole embed snippet, preconnect tags included, works fine); rejects any other host.
hex_get_google_fonts_urls() — the stored option, split into an array (one entry per line).
hex_get_google_font_families() — parses the distinct family names out of every stored URL's family= query parameter(s), decoding + stripping the axis-spec suffix and deduping.
hex_enqueue_google_fonts() — hooked wp_enqueue_scripts; wp_enqueue_style()s each stored URL directly (no local version, it's an external resource).
hex_google_fonts_resource_hints( $urls, $relation_type ) — hooked wp_resource_hints; adds the same two preconnect hints Google's own embed snippet uses, only when at least one font URL is configured.
hex_render_google_fonts_datalist() — prints the shared <datalist id="hex-google-fonts-list"> every font-family field's searchable input points to.

package.json.purpose: devDependencies only: tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/cli, @tailwindcss/typography, animate.css. Scripts: build:css / build:css:front / build:css:admin / watch:css.

composer.json.purpose: require: yahnis-elsts/plugin-update-checker (runtime). require-dev: PHPCS + WPCS + PHPCompatibility, PHPUnit + WP_Mock (dev tooling only).

phpcs.xml.dist.purpose: WordPress Coding Standards ruleset (WordPress + PHPCompatibilityWP, testVersion 8.0-). Excludes inc/lib (vendored third-party code).

phpunit.xml.dist.purpose: PHPUnit config; bootstraps tests/bootstrap.php; suite = tests/*Test.php.

tests/bootstrap.php.purpose: WP_Mock bootstrap + plain stub functions (add_action/add_filter/wp_parse_url/__/esc_html__) + a minimal WP_Error class stub + requires every inc/*.php (incl. updater.php, child-theme.php, style-settings.php, google-fonts.php, admin/settings.php) once.

tests/GoogleFontsTest.php.purpose: 18 tests for inc/google-fonts.php — URL sanitizing, family-name parsing, the front-end enqueue, the resource-hints filter, and the rendered <datalist>. See knoladge/google-fonts-picker.md.

tests/TemplateTagsTest.php.purpose: Covers hex_should_show_title() and hex_should_show_chrome() for every template.

tests/ThemeFilesTest.php.purpose: Static checks: required files exist, page templates match hex_get_page_templates(), style.css Version == HEX_VERSION.

tests/UpdaterTest.php.purpose: Covers the updater's own logic (branch default, 'not configured' graceful paths, both sanitize callbacks) — not the third-party library itself.

tests/ChildThemeTest.php.purpose: Covers the fetch/validate functions (header parsing, non-200, missing Template:, wp_remote_get() failure, template mismatch), install's early-return validation paths, branch default, active-detection (none/any-active/live-vs-stored), 'no child theme yet' graceful paths, and the child sanitize callback — not the actual Theme_Upgrader/WP_Filesystem install or a real PucFactory build.

tests/StyleSettingsTest.php.purpose: Covers the design-token schema (>=100 fields, every field's group is documented, every field has a real sanitize callback), naming transforms, value resolution, the CSS-var output builder (incl. shadow-keyword resolution and the injection-defense skip of an unsafe stored value), and all 6 sanitize callbacks' accept/reject-and-revert behavior.
